The official dataset summary confirms 1 km x 1 km tiles, 0.5 m x 0.5 m grid spacing, four quadrant groups and acquisition on 18 March 2006, and this window resolves the exact public ZIP BelfastCityLidar_SouthWest_18032006.zip; the ZIP fetch failed because the web transport does not support application/zip, so no archive-internal tile filename, CRS, geometry or parcel binding is fabricated.
